I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An Allotment of land in extent of about 0.0779 Hectare depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Maha/TMP/2022/1000 dated 19.12.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Hithgodawalpola alias Bebilapitiya in the Grama Niladhari Division of Hithgodawalpola (298) in the Minor Division of Thumpane Udapalatha East in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thumpane in Kandy District in Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta – Extent: 0.0779 Hectare North: Road; East: Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta claimed by G. A. G. Anura Kumara Siriwardhena; South: Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta claimed by G. A. G. Anura Kumara Siriwardhena, Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta claimed by S. N. Galanga, Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta claimed by Dialogue Instutute and Road; West: Road and Bebilapitiya Watta alias Saint John Watta claimed by G. A. G. Anura Kumara Siriwardhena.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/406.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.
